title: GPBam: A Retrieval-Aware German Public Law Exam Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2611.18981v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Legal reasoning in civil-law systems is not rule-lookup: the German state examination asks for a structured opinion (Gutachten) that names the governing norms, applies them to the facts, and argues to a conclusion. We introduce GPBam (German Public Law Bar-style Exam), 81 public-law examination cases with reference solutions, paired with a recitation task over 200 statutory provisions. Drawn from state examination preparation, the cases are broad and rarely repeat, and are not publicly available - we find no evidence of exact-solution memorisation in the models we evaluate, and keeping them private limits contamination. Because each reference solution's cited norms form a retrieval gold set over the very instances the essays are graded on, GPBam scores retrieval and long-form generation jointly, which makes it a benchmark for legal retrieval as well as for legal writing and lets us ask how much retrieval quality a legal opinion actually

translated_title: GPBam：一个检索感知的德国公法考试基准
translated_abstract: 大陆法系中的法律推理并非简单的规则查询：德国国家考试要求考生撰写结构化的鉴定意见，即指明适用规范、将其应用于案件事实并进行论证得出结论。我们提出了 GPBam（German Public Law Bar-style Exam，德国公法司法考试式基准），包含81个附有参考答案的公法考试案例，并配套一项涵盖200条法律条文的背诵任务。这些案例取自国家考试备考材料，覆盖面广且很少重复，且不对外公开——我们在所评估的模型中未发现对精确答案的记忆迹象，保持其非公开性也限制了数据污染。由于每个参考答案所引用的规范构成了对论文评分所依据实例的检索黄金集，GPBam 能够联合评估检索与长文本生成能力，这使其既是法律写作的基准，也是法律检索的基准，并让我们能够探究一份法律意见书究竟需要多高的检索质量。
tldr: 提出GPBam基准，通过81个非公开的德国公法考试案例与200条法条背诵任务，联合评估模型的法条检索能力与长篇法律写作能力，并有效限制数据污染。
en_tdlr: GPBam is a benchmark of 81 non-public German public law exam cases with a statutory recitation task that jointly scores legal retrieval and long-form legal writing while limiting data contamination.
